verdict.rationale: CHKit lets users and agents describe, validate, test, and deploy schema and pipelines as code in CI with a reviewable diff, which covers versioning and review of pipeline automations. Point-in-time recovery and time travel roll back data, not automation definitions, so automation rollback is only implied by redeploying earlier code. missing for 10: documented rollback of automations/pipelines, versioning of other automations (alert rules, batch jobs), detailed CHKit docs, independent corroboration.
